entries.title: Psalms 28:1
segments:
My rock; my firm and unfailing support. 
 
Nothing but the grace of God and constant help from him, can keep even believers from falling away to their own destruction.

entries.title: Psalms 28:2
segments: Thy holy oracle; the inner sanctuary, where God dwelt between the cherubim.

entries.title: Psalms 28:3
segments: Draw me not away; take me not away to punishment.

entries.title: Psalms 28:5
segments: Disregard of God and his ways is the means of destruction to those who continue in it.

entries.title: Psalms 28:7
segments: Trust in the Lord is the sure means of defence from all enemies, and a preparation for everlasting joy and praise.

entries.title: Psalms 28:8
segments:
Their strength; the strength of his people. 
 
  His anointed; David, as the anointed head of God's people, representing Christ, who is in a higher sense the anointed of God.
